title.en: Reward of Fasting in the Month of Rajab
title.rurdu: Mahe Rajab mein Roza rakhne ka sawaab

desc.en: Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fazzaal narrated on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ali ibn Moosa al-Reza (a) that, “Paradise is assured for whoever fasts on the first day of the month of Rajab hoping to be rewarded by Allah - Mighty and Majestic be He -۔ The intercession of whoever fasts on one of the middle days of that month on behalf of as many people as there are in the Rabee’ and Mozar tribes will be accepted. Allah, Mighty and Glorified be He, will make whoever fasts on the last day of that month one of the kings in Paradise. Also Allah, Mighty and Glorified be He, will accept his intercession on behalf of his father, mother, son, daughter, sister, paternal uncle, paternal aunt, maternal uncle, maternal aunt, friends and neighbors, even if some of them deserve the Fire.”

Abdus Salaam ibn Saaleh al-Harawi narrated on the authority of Imam Reza (a) that he (a) said: “One who observes fast on the first day of the month of Rajab, Allah is pleased with him when he meets Allah. One who observers two fasts in the month of Rajab, Allah will be pleased with him when he meets Allah. One who observes three fasts in the month of Rajab, All will be pleased with him and he will be agreed with him confessing the status of this month and will meet his Lord on the Day of Judgment. One who observes fast for seven days in the month of Rajab, Allah will open all the seven gates of Heaven for his soul so that after his death he could be elevated to the highest place in Paradise. One who observes fast for eight days in the month of Rajab, eight gates of Paradise shall be opened for him. One who observes fast for fifteen days in the month of Rajab, all his demands will be fulfilled by Allah except that the prayer should not be for the severing of ties in kinship (Qat’e Rahm) and who observes fast for the whole month of Rajab his sins will be forgiven as the one who would have come out of his mother’s womb sinless and the fire of hell will not touch him and he will enter Paradise along with virtuous persons.” Imam Reza (a) said…

arabic.text: مَنْ صَامَ يَوْمَ الثَّامِنِ وَالْعِشْرِيْنَ مِنْ رَجَبٍ كَانَ صَوْمُهٗ لِذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ كَفَّارَةَ تِسْعِيْنَ سَنَةً۔

lines.rarabic: MAN SAAMA YAUMAS SAAMENE WAL-I’SH-REENA MIN RAJABIN KAANA SAWMO-HU LE-ZAALE-KAL YAUME KAF-FAARA-TA TAS-E’ENA SANATAN.

trans.en: One who observes fast on 28th Rajab it would be expiation (compensation) of 90 years.
trans.rurdu: Agar koi 28th Mahe Rajab ko roza rakkhe to uske 90 saal ke gunah bakhsh diye jaayenge.
trans.urdu: اگر کوئی ۲۸ ماہ رجب کو روزہ رکھے تو اسکے ۹۰ سال کے گناہ بخش دیئے جائیں گے۔

arabic.text: مَنْ صَامَ يَوْمَ التَّاسِعِ وَالْعِشْرِيْنَ مِنْ رَجَبٍ كَانَ صَوْمُهٗ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمَ كَفَّارَةَ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ۔

lines.rarabic: MAN SAAMA YAUMAT TAASE-E’ WAL-I’SH-REENA MIN RAJABIN KAANA SAWMO-HU ZAALE-KAL YAUMA KAF-FAARA-TA ME-ATE SANATAN.

trans.en: One who observes fast on 29th Rajab it would be expiation (compensation) of 100 years.
trans.rurdu: Agar koi 29th Mahe Rajab ko roza rakkhe to uske 90 saal ke gunah bakhsh diye jaayenge.
trans.urdu: اگر کوئی ۲۹ ماہ رجب کو روزہ رکھے تو اسکے ۹۰ سال کے گناہ بخش دیئے جائیں گے۔

arabic.text: مَنْ صَامَ يَوْمَ الثَّلَاثِیْنَ مِنْ رَجَبٍ غَفَرَ اللہُ لَہٗ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ دَنْۢبِہٖ وَمَا تَاَخَّرَ۔

lines.rarabic: MAN SAAMA YAUMAS SALAA SEENA MIN RAJABIN GHAFA-RAAL-LAAHO LAHU MAA TA-QADDA-MA MIN DAMBE-HI WA MAA TA-AKH-KHARA.

trans.en: One who observes fast on 30th Rajab Allah will forgive his past and future sins.
trans.rurdu: Agar koi 30th Mahe Rajab ko roza rakkhe to Allah (swt) uske maazi aur mustaqbil (past & future) gunaho’n ko bakhsh dega.
trans.urdu: اگر کوئی ۳۰ ماہ رجب کو روزہ رکھے تو اللہ تعالی اس کے ماضی اور مستقبل كے گناہوں کو بخش دےگا۔

title.en: Reward of Visiting the Shrine of Imam Reza (a) in the Month of Rajab

desc.en: Late Shaheed narrated: Visiting the shrines of all the Divine Leaders (Imams) on special occasions and visiting the shrine of Imam Reza (a) in the month of Rajab is recommended and without doubt it is one of the best deeds. It has been documented through reliable proofs in the book ‘Oyoon Akhbaar al-Reza (a)’ and ‘Kaamel al-Ziyaaraat’ on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sulaiman, “I asked Aba-Ja’far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Reza (a) about a man who has gone on his obligatory pilgrimage and has then gone on his Umrah (supererogatory) pilgrimage, and Allah, the Highest, has granted him success in performing both his obligatory and his Umrah pilgrimages. He has then gone to Medina and has expressed his submission to the Holy Prophet (a). He then went to visit your forefather, the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (a), knowing that he is rightfully the proof of Allah for His creatures, and the gate from which we must go to Him. Then he greeted him (Ali (a)). Then he went to visit Aba Abdullah Hussain ibn Ali (a), and greeted him. Then he went to Baghdad and greeted Abil Hasan Moosa (a). Then he went back to his hometown. If once again Allah, the Highest, has granted him the opportunity to go on pilgrimage, then a pilgrimage to whom is better under these conditions? Should he who has already performed his Hajj pilgrimage go on pilgrimage to the Kaaba, or should he journey towards Khorasan to greet and visit the shrine of your father Ali ibn Moosa al-Reza (a)?” Aba Ja’far (a) replied, “Yes. It is better for him to go towards Khorasan to greet my father (a). However, this should be done in the month of Rajab. It is not appropriate for him to do this now. Indeed if he does so, both of us will be blamed by the ruler.”

title.en: Ziyarat’e Rajabiyyah, To be recited in the Shrines of Holy Imams (a) in the Month of Rajab

desc.en: It has been narrated in the rites of month of Shaban that the best occasion for the visitation of the shrine of Imam Hussain (a) is 15th of Rajab and 15th of Shaban compared to other occasions.
desc.rurdu: Mahe Shaban ke amaal mein likkha huwa hai keh Imam Husain (a) ki ziyarat ko 15th Mahe Rajab aur 15th Mahe Shaban ki makhsoosi par jaana behtar hai digar makhsoosi ke muqaable mein.
desc.urdu: ماہِ شعبان کے اعمال میں لکھا ہوا ہے کہ امام حسینؑ کی زیارت کو ۱۵؍ماہِ رجب اور ۱۵؍ماہِ شعبان کی مخصوصی پر جانا بہتر ہے دگر مخصوصی کے مقابلہ میں۔
